g.text: Thermomix TM31-4C (120 V) power board NPVTM31LTA-3

g.desc: Thermomix TM31-4C (120 V) power board NPVTM31LTA-3

g.text: Traced from a working board by continuity tests; see notes for confidence levels

g.desc: Traced from a working board by continuity tests; see notes for confidence levels

g.text: HVDC_N = primary ground (NOT the logic GND)

g.desc: HVDC_N = primary ground (NOT the logic GND)

g.text: GND = hot logic ground = motor bus negative

g.desc: GND = hot logic ground = motor bus negative

g.text: NOTES (structure confirmed; transformer pin-out and several values NOT traced; ? = value not read)

g.desc: NOTES (structure confirmed; transformer pin-out and several values NOT traced; ? = value not read)

g.text: - Fed from mains BEFORE the relays (it must power the MCU before RY200/RY202 close). Exact tap (before/after L103) not confirmed; drawn after L103.

g.desc: - Fed from mains BEFORE the relays (it must power the MCU before RY200/RY202 close). Exact tap (before/after L103) not confirmed; drawn after L103.

g.text: - F101 T1 A; Z101 varistor position empty on this board; IC100 Panasonic MIP2E3D (forum reports MIP2E1D on 230 V boards); T100 marked D1D8A.

g.desc: - F101 T1 A; Z101 varistor position empty on this board; IC100 Panasonic MIP2E3D (forum reports MIP2E1D on 230 V boards); T100 marked D1D8A.

g.text: - Feedback: PC100 + IC200 TL431 regulate the hot-side +5V. Clamp ZD101/D104, the aux winding and the IC100 pin-out are drawn functionally (DX5 = aux rectifier).

g.desc: - Feedback: PC100 + IC200 TL431 regulate the hot-side +5V. Clamp ZD101/D104, the aux winding and the IC100 pin-out are drawn functionally (DX5 = aux rectifier).

g.text: - Hot-side outputs are referenced to GND (= motor bus negative = MCU ground). The cold output (VCOLD / GND_COLD) is the only isolated rail.

g.desc: - Hot-side outputs are referenced to GND (= motor bus negative = MCU ground). The cold output (VCOLD / GND_COLD) is the only isolated rail.

g.text: INPUT RECTIFIER & FILTER (fed before the relays)
